hadithList: Actions are but by intentions and every man shall have only that which he intended.

Islam has been built on five pillars: testifying that there is no deity worthy of worship except Allah and that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah, establishing the prayer, paying the Zakat, making the pilgrimage to the House, and fasting in Ramadan.
Part of the perfection of one's Islam is his leaving that which does not concern him.
None of you truly believes until he loves for his brother that which he loves for himself.
A person who calls others to right guidance will have a reward as that of those who follow him.
Be in this world as though you were a stranger or a traveler.
Do not become angry.
Allah has prescribed proficiency in all things. So if you kill, kill well; and if you slaughter, slaughter well.
Fear Allah wherever you are, and follow up a bad deed with a good deed and it will wipe it out, and behave well towards people.
Know that if the nation were to gather together to benefit you with anything, they would not benefit you except with something that Allah had already prescribed for you.
If you feel no shame, then do as you wish.
Say: I believe in Allah, and then stand firm.
The doors of goodness are many: glorifying Allah, praising Allah, fasting, giving charity, enjoining what is good and forbidding what is evil.
Righteousness is good character, and sin is that which wavers in your heart and which you do not want people to know about.
Allah the Almighty is Good and accepts only that which is good.
Let him who believes in Allah and the Last Day either speak good or keep silent; and let him who believes in Allah and the Last Day be generous to his neighbour.
Do not envy one another, and do not inflate prices for one another, and do not hate one another, and do not turn away from one another.
Whoever relieves a believer's distress of the distressful aspects of this world, Allah will rescue him from a difficulty of the difficulties of the Hereafter.
Whoever shows the way to something good shall have a reward similar to that of its doer.
Allah is helpful to a servant as long as the servant is helpful to his brother.

If you guarantee me six things on your part I shall guarantee you Paradise: speak the truth when you talk, keep a promise when you make it, when you are trusted with something fulfil your trust, avoid sexual immorality, lower your gaze, and restrain your hands from injustice.
Allah has prescribed proficiency in all things. Verily Allah has prescribed proficiency in killing. If you kill then do it well.
Purity is half of faith. Al-Hamdu Lillah fills the scale. SubhanAllah and Al-Hamdu Lillah fill what is between heaven and earth.
On the authority of Abu Hurayrah: The Messenger of Allah said, Allah said: I am as My servant thinks I am.
Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day should speak a good word or remain silent.
Make things easy and do not make them difficult, cheer the people up by conveying glad tidings to them and do not repulse them.
The best of you are those who learn the Quran and teach it.
Seeking knowledge is an obligation upon every Muslim.
The strong man is not the one who can overpower others, but the strong man is the one who controls himself while in anger.
No one of you truly believes until he desires for his brother that which he desires for himself.
Whoever of you sees an evil, let him change it with his hand; and if he is not able to do so, then with his tongue; and if he is not able to do so, then with his heart.
The world is a prison for the believer and a paradise for the disbeliever.
Speak the truth even if it is bitter.
The best of deeds is the prayer performed on time, then kindness to parents, then Jihad in the way of Allah.

Take advantage of five before five: your youth before your old age, your health before your illness, your wealth before your poverty, your free time before your preoccupation, and your life before your death.
Smiling at your brother is an act of charity.
A good word is a charity.
Whoever removes a worldly grief from a believer, Allah will remove from him one of the griefs of the Day of Resurrection.
The merciful will be shown mercy by the Most Merciful. Be merciful to those on the earth and the One in the heavens will have mercy upon you.
Feed the hungry, visit the sick, and free the captives.

qaData.q: Namaz ki kitni rakaten hoti hain?
qaData.a: Paanch waqt ki namazein hain: Fajr (4), Dhuhr (12), Asr (8), Maghrib (7), Isha (17) — jin mein Fard, Sunnah aur Nafl shamil hain.

qaData.q: Wudu toot jane ki kya wajuhaat hain?
qaData.a: Wudu in wajuhaat se toot jata hai: (1) Qaza e hajat, (2) Riyah (gas) khaarij hona, (3) Gehri neend aana, (4) Behoshi, (5) Khoon ya pus nikalna jo beh jaye, (6) Qay karna agar munh bhar ho.

qaData.q: Kya auraton ki namaz mardoon se alag hoti hai?
qaData.a: Haan, auraton ke liye namaz ka andaz thoda alag hai — maslan haath baandhne, ruku aur sajdah mein fark hota hai. Auraten jism ko zyada sameta kar namaz ada karti hain.

qaData.q: Qaza namaz kya hoti hai aur kaise ada ki jati hai?
qaData.a: Jo namaz apne waqt par ada na ho sake, use Qaza kehte hain. Qaza namaz utni hi rakaton mein ada ki jati hai jitni fard hain — sirf fard rakaten qaza hoti hain, sunnah nahi.

qaData.q: Quran mein kitne para, surah aur ayat hain?
qaData.a: Quran Majeed mein 30 Para, 114 Surah aur 6,236 Ayaat hain. Sabse badi surah Al-Baqarah (286 ayaat) aur sabse chhoti surah Al-Kawthar (3 ayaat) hai.

qaData.q: Quran ka tarjuma parhna kaisa hai?
qaData.a: Quran ka tarjuma (translation) parhna jaiz aur mustahsan hai taake maa'na samjha ja sake. Lekin asli sawab Arabic matan parhne se milta hai. Dono mila kar parhna sabse behtar hai.

qaData.q: Bila wuzu Quran chu sakte hain?
qaData.a: Jumhoor ulama ke mutabiq bila wuzu Quran Majeed ko haath lagana jaiz nahi. Haan, tarjuma ya tafseer ki kitaab bila wuzu chhui ja sakti hai. Mobile ya tablet par bila wuzu parhne mein gunjaaish hai.
Roza har baligh, aaqil (sane), muqeem (muqim) Muslim mard aur aurat par farz hai. Beemar, musafir, haamilah aur haiz/nifas wali auraten roza chhod sakti hain aur baad mein qaza karein.

qaData.q: Roza torne wali cheezein konsi hain?
qaData.a: Jaan bujhkar kuch khana peena, jaan bujhkar qay karna, humbistari karna — ye sab roza tor dete hain. Ghalti se kuch kha lena, khwaab mein ehtelaam hona ya neend mein kuch kha lena roza nahi torta.

qaData.q: Ramadan mein raat ko kitne baje tak sehri kha sakte hain?
qaData.a: Sehri Subah Sadiq (Fajr ka waqt) se pehle pehle khani chahiye. Ihtiyatan Azan se 10-15 minute pehle khaana band kar dena chahiye. Azan ke baad sehri khana jaiz nahi.

qaData.q: Zakat kis par farz hoti hai?
qaData.a: Zakat us Muslim par farz hai jis ke paas Nisab ke barabar maal ho aur us par poora ek saal (Haul) guzar jaye. Nisab sone ka: 7.5 tola (87.48g), chandi ka: 52.5 tola (612.36g) ya uske barabar raqam.

qaData.q: Zakat ka nisab kitna hai aur kitni di jati hai?
qaData.a: Nisab ki tafeel: Sona 87.48 gram ya Chandi 612.36 gram ya uske barabar cash. Agar itna maal ek saal ke liye paas rahe to kul maal ka 2.5% zakat deni hogi.

Iman ke 7 arkaan hain: (1) Allah par, (2) Malaika par, (3) Aasmani Kutub par, (4) Anbiya wa Rusul par, (5) Qayamat ke din par, (6) Taqdeer (khair wa shar) par, (7) Marne ke baad dobara uthaye jane par.

Islam ke 5 arkaan hain: (1) Shahada — La ilaha illallah Muhammadur Rasulullah, (2) Salah — Paanch waqt ki namaz, (3) Zakat — Maal ka 2.5% ghareebon ko dena, (4) Sawm — Ramadan ke roze, (5) Hajj — Mustati ke liye.
Tawheed ka matlab hai Allah ki Wahdat (Oneness) par yakeen rakhna — ke Allah ek hai, uska koi shareek nahi, na ibaadat mein, na sifaat mein, na hukm mein. Ye Islam ka bunyadi aqeedah hai.

shahada.arabic: لَا إِلٰهَ إِلَّا الله مُحَمَّدٌ رَسُولُ الله
shahada.title: Shahada (Faith)
shahada.description: The declaration of faith is the foundational pillar of Islam. It is the sincere recitation of the statement that there is no god but Allah and Muhammad is His messenger.
details: The core entry point into the Muslim community.
Requires both verbal testimony and internal belief.
Unifies the concepts of Tawhid (Oneness) and Risalah (Prophethood).
shahada.importance: The declaration of Shahada provides a profound sense of purpose and identity, grounding the believer's life in the worship of the Creator.

guide.title: Understand the Meaning
guide.desc: Internalize the profound depth of declaring Allah as the only deity.

guide.title: Recite with Sincerity
guide.desc: The testimony should be spoken clearly with full heart and soul.

guide.title: Live the Testimony
guide.desc: Ensure daily actions align with the submission expressed in the declaration.

salah.title: Salah (Prayer)
salah.description: The five daily prayers are the spiritual backbone of a Muslim's life, performed at specific times from dawn until night.
details: Performed five times daily: Fajr, Dhuhr, Asr, Maghrib, and Isha.
Direct communication between the worshipper and Allah.
salah.importance: Salah serves as a constant reminder of our connection to the Divine, purifying the heart and soul through regular devotion.

guide.title: Perform Wudu
guide.desc: Cleanse yourself physically and spiritually before approaching prayer.

guide.title: Face the Qibla
guide.desc: Align your direction towards the Kaaba in Makkah.

guide.title: Focus and Humility
guide.desc: Enter prayer with a present heart and complete devotion (Khushu).

zakat.title: Zakat (Charity)
zakat.description: Zakat is the obligatory giving of a portion of one's wealth to those in need, serving as a form of social purification.
details: Typically 2.5% of surplus wealth held for a year.
Purifies wealth and heart from greed and selfishness.
Provides social security for the less fortunate in the community.
zakat.importance: Zakat bridges the gap between the rich and the poor, ensuring that the wealth of the community circulates fairly.

guide.title: Calculate Nisab
guide.desc: Determine if your wealth exceeds the minimum threshold for Zakat.

guide.title: Identify Recipients
guide.desc: Ensure your Zakat goes to one of the eight eligible categories defined in the Quran.

guide.title: Give with Sincerity
guide.desc: Give with a happy heart, seeking only the pleasure of Allah.

sawm.title: Sawm (Fasting)
sawm.description: Fasting during the holy month of Ramadan involves abstaining from food and drink from dawn until sunset.
details: Required for all healthy adult Muslims during Ramadan.
Includes spiritual fasting from bad speech and negative actions.
Culminates in the celebration of Eid al-Fitr.
sawm.importance: Sawm develops self-discipline, empathy for the hungry, and heightens spiritual consciousness (Taqwa).

guide.title: Intention (Niyyah)
guide.desc: Make a sincere intention to fast before the break of dawn.

guide.title: Patience and Prayer
guide.desc: Spend the day in worship, avoiding arguments and idle talk.

guide.title: Iftar and Gratitude
guide.desc: Break your fast at sunset with dates and water, thanking Allah.

hajj.title: Hajj (Pilgrimage)
hajj.description: The annual pilgrimage to the holy city of Makkah, which every Muslim must perform once in their lifetime if physically and financially able.
details: Takes place during the month of Dhu al-Hijjah.
Universal gathering of Muslims from all over the world.
Involves specific rituals including Tawaf and standing at Arafat.
hajj.importance: Hajj symbolizes human equality and submission to Allah, as millions gather in simple white garments regardless of status.

guide.title: Preparation
guide.desc: Ensure all debts are paid and seek forgiveness before traveling.

guide.title: Enter Ihram
guide.desc: Adopt the state of ritual sanctity and put on the required garments.

guide.title: Perform the Rites
guide.desc: Follow the steps of the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) with patience.

wuduSteps.title: Niyyah & Bismillah
wuduSteps.desc: Make the intention in your heart to perform Wudu purely for the sake of Allah, and say “Bismillah”.

wuduSteps.title: Wash Hands
wuduSteps.desc: Wash both hands up to the wrists three times, ensuring water reaches between the fingers.

wuduSteps.title: Rinse Mouth
wuduSteps.desc: Take water into the mouth and rinse thoroughly three times (Madmadah).

wuduSteps.title: Rinse Nose
wuduSteps.desc: Sniff water gently into the nostrils and blow it out, three times (Istinshaq).

wuduSteps.title: Wash Face
wuduSteps.desc: Wash the face from forehead to chin and ear to ear, three times.

wuduSteps.title: Wash Arms
wuduSteps.desc: Wash the right arm then the left arm up to and including the elbows, three times each.

wuduSteps.title: Wipe Head & Ears
wuduSteps.desc: Wipe the head once with wet hands, then wipe the inside and outside of both ears.

wuduSteps.title: Wash Feet
wuduSteps.desc: Wash the right foot then the left foot up to and including the ankles, three times each.

masnoonDuas.title: Dua e Subah
masnoonDuas.subtitle: Morning Dua
masnoonDuas.arabic: اَللّٰهُمَّ بِكَ اَصْبَحْنَا وَبِكَ اَمْسَيْنَا وَبِكَ نَحْيَا وَبِكَ نَمُوْتُ وَاِلَيْكَ النُّشُوْرُ
masnoonDuas.translation: "O Allah, by You we enter the morning, by You we enter the evening, by You we live, by You we die, and to You is the resurrection."

masnoonDuas.title: Dua e Shaam
masnoonDuas.subtitle: Evening Dua
masnoonDuas.arabic: اَللّٰهُمَّ بِكَ اَمْسَيْنَا وَبِكَ اَصْبَحْنَا وَبِكَ نَحْيَا وَبِكَ نَمُوْتُ وَاِلَيْكَ الْمَصِيْرُ
masnoonDuas.translation: "O Allah, by You we enter the evening, by You we enter the morning, by You we live, by You we die, and to You is the return."

masnoonDuas.title: Ghar Se Nikalnay Ki Dua
masnoonDuas.subtitle: Leaving Home
masnoonDuas.arabic: بِسْمِ اللهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَى اللهِ وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ اِلَّا بِاللهِ
masnoonDuas.translation: "In the name of Allah, I place my trust in Allah, and there is no power and no strength except with Allah."

masnoonDuas.title: Ghar Mein Daakhil Honay Ki Dua
masnoonDuas.subtitle: Entering Home
masnoonDuas.arabic: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّىْ اَسْئَلُكَ خَيْرَ الْمَوْلِجِ وَخَيْرَ الْمَخْرَجِ
masnoonDuas.translation: "O Allah, I ask You for the best entry and the best exit."

masnoonDuas.title: Khanay Se Pehle Ki Dua
masnoonDuas.subtitle: Before Eating
masnoonDuas.arabic: بِسْمِ اللهِ وَعَلٰى بَرَكَةِ اللهِ
masnoonDuas.translation: "In the name of Allah and with the blessings of Allah."

masnoonDuas.title: Khanay Ky Baad Ki Dua
masnoonDuas.subtitle: After Eating
masnoonDuas.arabic: اَلْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ الَّذِيْ اَطْعَمَنَا وَسَقَانَا وَجَعَلَنَا مُسْلِمِيْنَ
masnoonDuas.translation: "All praise is for Allah Who fed us, gave us drink, and made us Muslims."

masnoonDuas.title: Wudu Shuru Karnay Ki Dua
masnoonDuas.subtitle: Starting Wudu
masnoonDuas.arabic: بِسْمِ اللهِ الرَّحْمٰنِ الرَّحِيْمِ
masnoonDuas.translation: "In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful."

masnoonDuas.title: Wudu Ky Baad Ki Dua
masnoonDuas.subtitle: After Wudu
masnoonDuas.arabic: اَشْهَدُ اَنْ لَّا اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اللهُ وَحْدَهٗ لَا شَرِيْكَ لَهٗ وَاَشْهَدُ اَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُهٗ وَرَسُوْلُهٗ
masnoonDuas.translation: "I bear witness that there is no god but Allah, alone without partner, and I bear witness that Muhammad is His servant and messenger."

masnoonDuas.title: Sonay Ki Dua
masnoonDuas.subtitle: Before Sleeping
masnoonDuas.arabic: اَللّٰهُمَّ بِاسْمِكَ اَمُوْتُ وَاَحْيَا
masnoonDuas.translation: "O Allah, in Your name I die and I live."

masnoonDuas.title: Neend Se Uthny Ki Dua
masnoonDuas.subtitle: Waking Up
masnoonDuas.arabic: اَلْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ الَّذِيْ اَحْيَانَا بَعْدَ مَا اَمَاتَنَا وَاِلَيْهِ النُّشُوْرُ
masnoonDuas.translation: "All praise is for Allah Who gave us life after death and to Him is the resurrection."

masnoonDuas.title: Toilet Jaane Ki Dua
masnoonDuas.subtitle: Entering Toilet
masnoonDuas.arabic: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّىْ اَعُوْذُبِكَ مِنَ الْخُبُثِ وَالْخَبَآئِثِ
masnoonDuas.translation: "O Allah, I seek Your protection from male and female devils."

masnoonDuas.title: Toilet Se Nikalnay Ki Dua
masnoonDuas.subtitle: Leaving Toilet
masnoonDuas.arabic: غُفْرَانَكَ
masnoonDuas.translation: "I seek Your forgiveness."

masnoonDuas.title: Masjid Mein Daakhil Honay Ki Dua
masnoonDuas.subtitle: Entering Mosque
masnoonDuas.arabic: اَللّٰهُمَّ افْتَحْ لِيْ اَبْوَابَ رَحْمَتِكَ
masnoonDuas.translation: "O Allah, open for me the doors of Your mercy."

masnoonDuas.title: Masjid Se Nikalnay Ki Dua
masnoonDuas.subtitle: Leaving Mosque
masnoonDuas.arabic: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّىْ اَسْئَلُكَ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ
masnoonDuas.translation: "O Allah, I ask You from Your bounty."

masnoonDuas.title: Safar Ki Dua
masnoonDuas.subtitle: Travelling
masnoonDuas.arabic: سُبْحَانَ الَّذِيْ سَخَّرَلَنَا هٰذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهٗ مُقْرِنِيْنَ وَاِنَّآ اِلٰى رَبِّنَا لَمُنْقَلِبُوْنَ
masnoonDuas.translation: "Glory be to Him Who has subjected this to us, and we were not able to do it, and surely to our Lord we must return."

masnoonDuas.title: Beemar Ki Iyaadat Ki Dua
masnoonDuas.subtitle: Visiting the Sick
masnoonDuas.arabic: لَا بَاْسَ طَهُوْرٌ اِنْ شَآءَ اللهُ
masnoonDuas.translation: "Do not worry, it is a purification, if Allah wills."

masnoonDuas.title: Dua e Qunoot
masnoonDuas.subtitle: Witr Prayer
masnoonDuas.arabic: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنَّا نَسْتَعِيْنُكَ وَنَسْتَغْفِرُكَ وَنُؤْمِنُ بِكَ وَنَتَوَكَّلُ عَلَيْكَ وَنُثْنِيْ عَلَيْكَ الْخَيْرَ
masnoonDuas.translation: "O Allah, we seek Your help and ask Your forgiveness and believe in You and trust in You and praise You in the best way."

masnoonDuas.title: Baarish Ki Dua
masnoonDuas.subtitle: During Rain
masnoonDuas.arabic: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَيِّبًا نَافِعًا
masnoonDuas.translation: "O Allah, make it a beneficial rain."

masnoonDuas.title: Aandhi Ki Dua
masnoonDuas.subtitle: During Storm
masnoonDuas.arabic: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّىْ اَسْئَلُكَ خَيْرَهَا وَخَيْرَ مَا فِيْهَا وَاَعُوْذُبِكَ مِنْ شَرِّهَا وَشَرِّ مَا فِيْهَا
masnoonDuas.translation: "O Allah, I ask You for its good and the good within it, and I seek refuge in You from its evil and the evil within it."

masnoonDuas.title: Naya Chand Dekhne Ki Dua
masnoonDuas.subtitle: Seeing New Moon
masnoonDuas.arabic: اَللّٰهُ اَكْبَرُ اَللّٰهُمَّ اَهِلَّهٗ عَلَيْنَا بِالْيُمْنِ وَالْاِيْمَانِ
masnoonDuas.translation: "Allah is the Greatest. O Allah, let this moon appear over us with blessings and faith."

masnoonDuas.title: Qarz Ada Honay Ki Dua
masnoonDuas.subtitle: Paying Off Debt
masnoonDuas.arabic: اَللّٰهُمَّ اكْفِنِيْ بِحَلَالِكَ عَنْ حَرَامِكَ وَاَغْنِنِيْ بِفَضْلِكَ عَمَّنْ سِوَاكَ
masnoonDuas.translation: "O Allah, suffice me with what You have made lawful against what You have forbidden, and make me independent with Your bounty."

masnoonDuas.title: Naye Bachay Ki Dua
masnoonDuas.subtitle: Newborn Baby
masnoonDuas.arabic: بَارَكَ اللهُ لَكَ فِي الْمَوْهُوْبِ لَكَ وَشَكَرْتَ الْوَاهِبَ وَبَلَغَ اَشُدَّهٗ وَرُزِقْتَ بِرَّهٗ
masnoonDuas.translation: "May Allah bless you in what was given to you, may you be grateful to the Giver, and may he reach maturity and may you be granted his righteousness."

masnoonDuas.title: Ilm Mein Izafa Ki Dua
masnoonDuas.subtitle: Seeking Knowledge
masnoonDuas.arabic: رَبِّ زِدْنِيْ عِلْمًا
masnoonDuas.translation: "O my Lord, increase me in knowledge."

masnoonDuas.title: Gham Aur Pareshani Ki Dua
masnoonDuas.subtitle: Grief & Worry
masnoonDuas.arabic: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّىْ عَبْدُكَ وَابْنُ عَبْدِكَ وَابْنُ اَمَتِكَ نَاصِيَتِيْ بِيَدِكَ
masnoonDuas.translation: "O Allah, I am Your servant, son of Your servant, son of Your maidservant. My forelock is in Your hand."

masnoonDuas.title: Beemar Hone Ki Dua
masnoonDuas.subtitle: When Sick
masnoonDuas.arabic: اَللّٰهُمَّ اَذْهِبِ الْبَاْسَ رَبَّ النَّاسِ اشْفِ وَاَنْتَ الشَّافِيْ
masnoonDuas.translation: "O Allah, remove the hardship, O Lord of mankind, grant cure, for You are the Healer."

masnoonDuas.title: Shaitaan Se Bachne Ki Dua
masnoonDuas.subtitle: Protection from Shaitan
masnoonDuas.arabic: اَعُوْذُ بِاللهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيْمِ
masnoonDuas.translation: "I seek refuge in Allah from the accursed devil."

masnoonDuas.title: Aainay Mein Dekhne Ki Dua
masnoonDuas.subtitle: Looking in Mirror
masnoonDuas.arabic: اَللّٰهُمَّ اَنْتَ حَسَّنْتَ خَلْقِيْ فَحَسِّنْ خُلُقِيْ
masnoonDuas.translation: "O Allah, just as You have made my appearance beautiful, make my character beautiful too."

masnoonDuas.title: Bazaar Mein Daakhil Honay Ki Dua
masnoonDuas.subtitle: Entering Market
masnoonDuas.arabic: لَا اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اللهُ وَحْدَهٗ لَا شَرِيْكَ لَهٗ لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ يُحْيِيْ وَيُمِيْتُ وَهُوَ حَيٌّ لَّا يَمُوْتُ
masnoonDuas.translation: "There is no god but Allah, alone without partner. His is the dominion and His is the praise. He gives life and causes death and He is living and never dies."

masnoonDuas.title: Nikah Ki Dua
masnoonDuas.subtitle: At Marriage
masnoonDuas.arabic: بَارَكَ اللهُ لَكَ وَبَارَكَ عَلَيْكَ وَجَمَعَ بَيْنَكُمَا فِيْ خَيْرٍ
masnoonDuas.translation: "May Allah bless you and shower blessings upon you and join you together in goodness."

masnoonDuas.title: Istighfar
masnoonDuas.subtitle: Seeking Forgiveness
masnoonDuas.arabic: اَسْتَغْفِرُ اللهَ الَّذِيْ لَا اِلٰهَ اِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّوْمُ وَاَتُوْبُ اِلَيْهِ
masnoonDuas.translation: "I seek forgiveness from Allah, besides Whom there is no god, the Ever-Living, the Self-Sustaining, and I turn to Him in repentance."

masnoonDuas.title: Achha Kaam Khatam Honay Ki Dua
masnoonDuas.subtitle: Completing Good Work
masnoonDuas.arabic: اَلْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ الَّذِيْ بِنِعْمَتِهٖ تَتِمُّ الصَّالِحَاتُ
masnoonDuas.translation: "All praise is for Allah by Whose blessing all good deeds are completed."

masnoonDuas.title: Sadqa Dene Ki Dua
masnoonDuas.subtitle: Giving Charity
masnoonDuas.arabic: رَبَّنَا تَقَبَّلْ مِنَّا اِنَّكَ اَنْتَ السَّمِيْعُ الْعَلِيْمُ
masnoonDuas.translation: "Our Lord, accept from us. Indeed You are the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing."

masnoonDuas.title: Mushkil Waqt Ki Dua
masnoonDuas.subtitle: Times of Difficulty
masnoonDuas.arabic: اِنَّا لِلّٰهِ وَاِنَّآ اِلَيْهِ رٰجِعُوْنَ
masnoonDuas.translation: "Indeed we belong to Allah and indeed to Him we shall return."

masnoonDuas.title: Darood Ibrahim
masnoonDuas.subtitle: Sending Blessings
masnoonDuas.arabic: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَّعَلٰى اٰلِ مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلٰى اِبْرَاهِيْمَ وَعَلٰى اٰلِ اِبْرَاهِيْمَ
masnoonDuas.translation: "O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad, as You sent blessings upon Ibrahim and the family of Ibrahim."

masnoonDuas.title: Sayyidul Istighfar
masnoonDuas.subtitle: Master of Forgiveness
masnoonDuas.arabic: اَللّٰهُمَّ اَنْتَ رَبِّيْ لَا اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اَنْتَ خَلَقْتَنِيْ وَاَنَا عَبْدُكَ وَاَنَا عَلٰى عَهْدِكَ وَوَعْدِكَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُ
masnoonDuas.translation: "O Allah, You are my Lord, there is no god but You. You created me and I am Your servant, and I abide by Your covenant and promise as best I can."

iman_mujmal.arabic: آمَنْتُ بِاللّٰهِ كَمَا هُوَ بِأَسْمَائِهِ وَصِفَاتِهِ وَقَبِلْتُ جَمِيعَ أَحْكَامِهِ إِقْرَارًا بِاللِّسَانِ وَتَصْدِيقًا بِالْقَلْبِ
iman_mujmal.translation: "I believe in Allah as He is, with all His names and attributes, and I accept all His commands by tongue and confirm by heart."

iman_mufassal.arabic: آمَنْتُ بِاللّٰهِ وَمَلَائِكَتِهِ وَكُتُبِهِ وَرُسُلِهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الْآخِرِ وَالْقَدَرِ خَيْرِهِ وَشَرِّهِ مِنَ اللّٰهِ تَعَالَى وَالْبَعْثِ بَعْدَ الْمَوْتِ
iman_mufassal.translation: "I believe in Allah, His angels, His books, His messengers, the Last Day, and in destiny — its good and evil from Allah, and in resurrection after death."

ayat_kursi.arabic: اللّٰهُ لَآ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّوْمُ ۚ لَا تَاْخُذُهٗ سِنَةٌ وَّلَا نَوْمٌ ۚ لَهٗ مَا فِي السَّمٰوٰتِ وَمَا فِي الْاَرْضِ ۗ مَنْ ذَا الَّذِيْ يَشْفَعُ عِنْدَهٗٓ اِلَّا بِاِذْنِهٖ ۚ يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ اَيْدِيْهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ ۚ وَلَا يُحِيْطُوْنَ بِشَيْءٍ مِّنْ عِلْمِهٖٓ اِلَّا بِمَا شَآءَ ۚ وَسِعَ كُرْسِيُّهُ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالْاَرْضَ ۚ وَلَا يَـُٔوْدُهٗ حِفْظُهُمَا ۚ وَهُوَ الْعَلِيُّ الْعَظِيْمُ
ayat_kursi.translation: "Allah — there is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer. Neither drowsiness nor sleep overtakes Him. To Him belongs all in the heavens and earth. None can intercede except by His permission. He knows what is before and after them. His Kursi extends over the heavens and earth, and their preservation tires Him not. He is the Most High, the Most Great."

dua_qunoot.arabic: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنَّا نَسْتَعِيْنُكَ وَنَسْتَغْفِرُكَ وَنُؤْمِنُ بِكَ وَنَتَوَكَّلُ عَلَيْكَ وَنُثْنِيْ عَلَيْكَ الْخَيْرَ وَنَشْكُرُكَ وَلَا نَكْفُرُكَ وَنَخْلَعُ وَنَتْرُكُ مَنْ يَّفْجُرُكَ ۔ اَللّٰهُمَّ اِيَّاكَ نَعْبُدُ وَلَكَ نُصَلِّيْ وَنَسْجُدُ وَاِلَيْكَ نَسْعٰى وَنَحْفِدُ وَنَرْجُوْ رَحْمَتَكَ وَنَخْشٰى عَذَابَكَ اِنَّ عَذَابَكَ بِالْكُفَّارِ مُلْحِقٌ
dua_qunoot.translation: "O Allah! We seek Your help, ask Your forgiveness, believe in You, and trust You. We praise You, thank You, and are not ungrateful. We forsake those who disobey You. O Allah! We worship only You, pray and prostrate to You, hasten toward You, and hope for Your mercy while fearing Your punishment. Surely Your punishment overtakes the disbelievers."

kalimas.title: Kalima Tayyiba
kalimas.arabic: لَآ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اللهُ مُحَمَّدٌ رَّسُوْلُ اللهِ
kalimas.translation: "There is no god but Allah, Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah."

kalimas.title: Kalima Shahadat
kalimas.arabic: اَشْهَدُ اَنْ لَّآ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اللهُ وَحْدَهٗ لَا شَرِيْكَ لَهٗ وَاَشْهَدُ اَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُهٗ وَرَسُوْلُهٗ
kalimas.translation: "I bear witness that there is no god but Allah, alone without any partner, and I bear witness that Muhammad is His servant and messenger."

kalimas.title: Kalima Tamjeed
kalimas.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللهِ وَالْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ وَلَآ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اللهُ وَاللهُ اَكْبَرُ وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ اِلَّا بِاللهِ الْعَلِيِّ الْعَظِيْمِ
kalimas.translation: "Glory be to Allah, and praise be to Allah, and there is no god but Allah, and Allah is the Greatest, and there is no power and no strength except with Allah, the Most High, the Most Great."

kalimas.title: Kalima Tauheed
kalimas.arabic: لَآ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اللهُ وَحْدَهٗ لَا شَرِيْكَ لَهٗ لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ يُحْيٖ وَيُمِيْتُ وَهُوَ حَيٌّ لَّا يَمُوْتُ اَبَدًا اَبَدًا ذُو الْجَلَالِ وَالْاِكْرَامِ بِيَدِهِ الْخَيْرُ وَهُوَ عَلٰى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيْرٌ
kalimas.translation: "There is no god but Allah, alone without any partner. To Him belongs the kingdom and to Him belongs all praise. He gives life and causes death, and He is Ever-Living and will never die. Ever. He is the Lord of Majesty and Honor. In His hand is all goodness, and He has power over all things."

kalimas.title: Kalima Astaghfar
kalimas.arabic: اَسْتَغْفِرُ اللهَ رَبِّيْ مِنْ كُلِّ ذَنْبٍ اَذْنَبْتُهٗ عَمَدًا اَوْ خَطَاً سِرًّا اَوْ عَلَانِيَةً وَّاَتُوْبُ اِلَيْهِ مِنَ الذَّنْبِ الَّذِيْ اَعْلَمُ وَمِنَ الذَّنْبِ الَّذِيْ لَآ اَعْلَمُ اِنَّكَ اَنْتَ عَلَّامُ الْغُيُوْبِ وَسَتَّارُ الْعُيُوْبِ وَغَفَّارُ الذُّنُوْبِ وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ اِلَّا بِاللهِ الْعَلِيِّ الْعَظِيْمِ
kalimas.translation: "I seek forgiveness from Allah, my Lord, for every sin I have committed intentionally or by mistake, secretly or openly. I repent to Him for sins I know and those I do not know. Surely You are the Knower of the unseen, the Concealer of faults, and the Forgiver of sins."

kalimas.title: Kalima Radde Kufr
kalimas.arabic: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّيْ اَعُوْذُبِكَ مِنْ اَنْ اُشْرِكَ بِكَ شَيْئًا وَّاَنَا اَعْلَمُ بِهٖ وَاَسْتَغْفِرُكَ لِمَا لَآ اَعْلَمُ بِهٖ تُبْتُ عَنْهُ وَتَبَرَّاْتُ مِنَ الْكُفْرِ وَالشِّرْكِ وَالْكِذْبِ وَالْغِيْبَةِ وَالْبِدْعَةِ وَالنَّمِيْمَةِ وَالْفَوَاحِشِ وَالْبُهْتَانِ وَالْمَعَاصِيْ كُلِّهَا وَاَسْلَمْتُ وَاَقُوْلُ لَآ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اللهُ مُحَمَّدٌ رَّسُوْلُ اللهِ
kalimas.translation: "O Allah! I seek refuge in You from knowingly associating any partner with You, and I seek Your forgiveness for those sins I am unaware of. I repent from disbelief, polytheism, lies, backbiting, innovation, slander, shameful acts, false accusations, and all sins. I submit to You and declare: There is no god but Allah, Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah."

namaz_lessons.title: Sana
namaz_lessons.translation: "Glory be to You, O Allah, and all praise is Yours, and blessed is Your name."

namaz_lessons.title: Al-Fatiha
namaz_lessons.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ ۝ الرَّحْمَنِ الرَّحِيمِ ۝ مَالِكِ يَوْمِ الدِّينِ
namaz_lessons.translation: "Praise be to Allah, Lord of all the worlds, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful, Master of the Day of Judgment."

namaz_lessons.title: Tasbih of Ruku
namaz_lessons.translation: "Glory be to my Lord, the Most Great." (recited 3 times while bowing)

namaz_lessons.title: Tasbih of Sajdah
namaz_lessons.translation: "Glory be to my Lord, the Most High." (recited 3 times in prostration)

namaz_lessons.title: Durood Ibrahim
namaz_lessons.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
namaz_lessons.translation: "O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad." — recited in the final sitting.

how_to_perform.title: Niyyah (Intention)
how_to_perform.desc: Stand straight facing the Qibla and make your intention in your heart for the specific prayer.

how_to_perform.title: Takbiratul Ihram
how_to_perform.desc: Raise your hands to your ears and say "Allahu Akbar" to enter the state of prayer.

how_to_perform.title: Qiyam (Standing)
how_to_perform.desc: Recite Sana, Ta'awwuz, Bismillah, Al-Fatiha, and a Surah from the Quran.

how_to_perform.title: Ruku (Bowing)
how_to_perform.desc: Bow with your back straight, hands on knees, and recite "Subhana Rabbiyal Azim" three times.

how_to_perform.title: Sajdah (Prostration)
how_to_perform.desc: Place forehead, nose, palms, knees, and toes on the ground and recite "Subhana Rabbiyal A'la" three times — twice with a short sitting in between.

how_to_perform.title: Tashahhud & Salam
how_to_perform.desc: In the final sitting, recite At-Tahiyyat, Durood, and Dua, then turn your face right then left saying "Assalamu Alaikum wa Rahmatullah" to end the prayer.

about_paragraphs: Islamic Coaching Institute (ICI) is a dedicated platform for spreading authentic Islamic knowledge and education to Muslims around the world.
Our mission is to make the learning of Quran, Hadith, and Islamic sciences accessible, structured, and easy for every Muslim — young and old.
